_comment: Synthetic Firm/Project/ProjectFirm rows keyed to specific accounts in account_roster_sample.csv, so accounts_matching_firm has something real to find. Deliberately covers all three real outcomes: a firm match with an active project, a firm match with only a dead project (present on the roster, but nothing live right now), and -- by leaving the other 38 accounts alone -- no firm match at all, the realistic majority case for a rep's contractor roster.
